# The Basics

Jelly is an extremely simple language, it pulls from Swift and Javascript for most of it's syntax. However some parts of the language like Metadata are Jelly specific. If you already know one of these languages, learning Jelly should not be very
hard. If you do not know either of these languages, the language guide will walk you though everything you need to know.

## How to go through this guide

I would recommend getting started by reading [Writing Your First Script](https://docs.jellycuts.com/Getting_Started/writing_first_script.html) in the [Getting Started](https://docs.jellycuts.com/Getting_Started/language_overview.html) section. After you have written a
simple script, look at this section for topics you do not understand or want to understand more about.
